result_summary.title: Slow Mobile App Performance and Intermittent Failures in EU-Central Staging
result_summary.description: Our mobile app is running very slowly and failing intermittently when using Payment Gateway v2 in staging. We are confident this is caused by a clock/time synchronization issue between your servers and our client devices. Please adjust your server time settings.
